(rule!
 ;; Color 8 is a rectangular occluder. The 4b-2 square is generated from a
 ;; 2b seed mirrored across both far axes; its off-diagonal b-blocks are
 ;; transposes. Recover each hidden cell from its full symmetry orbit.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define crop-marker #f)
   (define n (rows g))
   (define b (/ (+ n 2) 4))
   (define axis (+ n 1))
   (define hidden (find-color g 8))
   (define r0 (min-of first hidden))
   (define r1 (max-of first hidden))
   (define c0 (min-of second hidden))
   (define c1 (max-of second hidden))
   (define (inside? p)
    (and (>= (first p) 0) (< (first p) n) (>= (second p) 0) (< (second p) n)))
   (define (mirrors r c)
    (filter inside?
     (list (list r c) (list (- axis r) c) (list r (- axis c))
           (list (- axis r) (- axis c)))))
   (define (orbit r c)
    (let* ((rr (min r (- axis r))) (cc (min c (- axis c)))
           (off-diagonal
            (or (and (< rr b) (>= cc b) (< cc (* 2 b)))
                (and (< cc b) (>= rr b) (< rr (* 2 b))))))
     (if off-diagonal (append (mirrors r c) (mirrors cc rr)) (mirrors r c))))
   (define (recover r c)
    (let ((source
           (first (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at g (first p) (second p)) 8))
                          (orbit r c)))))
     (at g (first source) (second source))))
   (define patch
    (build-list (+ 1 (- r1 r0))
     (lambda (dr)
      (build-list (+ 1 (- c1 c0))
       (lambda (dc) (recover (+ r0 dr) (+ c0 dc)))))))
   (if crop-marker
    (let* ((colors (grid-colors patch))
           (rare
            (for/fold ((best (first colors))) ((color (in-list (rest colors))))
             (if (< (count-color patch color) (count-color patch best)) color best)))
           (cells (find-color patch rare))
           (mr0 (min-of first cells)) (mr1 (max-of first cells))
           (mc0 (min-of second cells)) (mc1 (max-of second cells)))
     (subgrid patch mr0 mc0 mr1 mc1))
    patch))))

(rule!
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define source-priority 1) ; 0 mirrors first, 1 transpose first
     (define h (rows g))
     (define w (cols g))
     (define (in-bounds? r c)
       (and (<= 0 r) (< r h) (<= 0 c) (< c w)))
     (define (axis-conflicts axis vertical?)
       (for*/sum ((r (in-range h)) (c (in-range w)))
         (let* ((rr (if vertical? r (- axis r)))
                (cc (if vertical? (- axis c) c)))
           (if (and (in-bounds? rr cc)
                    (if vertical? (< c cc) (< r rr))
                    (not (= (at g r c) 8))
                    (not (= (at g rr cc) 8))
                    (not (= (at g r c) (at g rr cc))))
               1 0))))
     (define (axis-overlap axis vertical?)
       (for*/sum ((r (in-range h)) (c (in-range w)))
         (let* ((rr (if vertical? r (- axis r)))
                (cc (if vertical? (- axis c) c)))
           (if (and (in-bounds? rr cc)
                    (if vertical? (< c cc) (< r rr))
                    (not (= (at g r c) 8))
                    (not (= (at g rr cc) 8)))
               1 0))))
     (define (best-axis vertical?)
       (define size (if vertical? w h))
       (define candidates
         (for/list ((axis (in-range 0 (- (* 2 size) 1)))
                    #:when (and (= (axis-conflicts axis vertical?) 0)
                                (> (axis-overlap axis vertical?) 0)))
           (list (axis-overlap axis vertical?) axis)))
       (define best (apply max (map first candidates)))
       (second (first (filter (lambda (x) (= (first x) best)) candidates))))
     (define row-axis (best-axis #f))
     (define col-axis (best-axis #t))
     (define holes (find-color g 8))
     (define r0 (apply min (map first holes)))
     (define r1 (apply max (map first holes)))
     (define c0 (apply min (map second holes)))
     (define c1 (apply max (map second holes)))
     (define (mirror-sources r c)
       (list (list r (- col-axis c))
             (list (- row-axis r) c)
             (list (- row-axis r) (- col-axis c))))
     (define (transpose-sources r c)
       (list (list c r)
             (list (- col-axis c) r)
             (list c (- row-axis r))
             (list (- col-axis c) (- row-axis r))))
     (define (source-for r c)
       (define candidates
         (if (= source-priority 0)
             (append (mirror-sources r c) (transpose-sources r c))
             (append (transpose-sources r c) (mirror-sources r c))))
       (first
        (filter
         (lambda (p)
           (let ((rr (first p)) (cc (second p)))
             (and (in-bounds? rr cc)
                  (not (member? p holes))
                  (not (= (at g rr cc) 8)))))
         candidates)))
     (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (- r1 r0)) (+ 1 (- c1 c0))
       (lambda (rr cc)
         (let* ((r (+ r0 rr)) (c (+ c0 cc)) (p (source-for r c)))
           (at g (first p) (second p))))))))
